name: little-keepsakes
description: The Lantern Picnic: a cinematic 3D fruit-merge picnic on a floating forest island. Five Blender-built toy friends, one evening from afternoon to a lantern festival. Plus The Lantern Trail, a short 2.5D adventure across Fernhollow's floating islets.

scripts.test: node --test tests/game.test.mjs tests/picnic.test.mjs tests/picnic-wishes.test.mjs tests/picnic-challenge.test.mjs tests/lantern.test.mjs tests/lantern-life.test.mjs tests/audio.test.mjs tests/resources.test.mjs tests/i18n.test.mjs tests/shop.test.mjs tests/quality.test.mjs tests/trail.test.mjs
scripts.test:lantern: node tests/lantern-browser.mjs && node tests/lantern-stage2d-browser.mjs && node tests/lantern-regressions-browser.mjs && node tests/lantern-ui-browser.mjs
scripts.test:lantern:3d: node tests/lantern-browser.mjs --quality=low && node tests/lantern-ui-browser.mjs --quality=low && node tests/lantern-languages-browser.mjs --quality=low
scripts.test:browser: node tests/picnic-browser.mjs && node tests/picnic-combo-browser.mjs && node tests/picnic-coins-browser.mjs
scripts.assets: npm run assets:blender && npm run assets:icons && npm run assets:keyart
